title: Look for a cheaper one
text: Look for a cheaper one. The instructions are confusing at best and wrong at worst. It’s  a good thing I don’t have kids or the whole tree would wobble and tip over because the base isn’t very secure. I don’t know if my pieces are warped or what but even managing to use what I assume are supposed to secure the boughs down some still shake and fall off where others have to be crammed into place never to move again. The paint chips very easily. Once I managed to engineer it myself (the instructions are lacking and what they do contain is mostly incorrect) it looks pretty nice.
